authorizeBatchSponsors(address[]).details: Can only be called by the user themselves (when their EOA has this contract as implementation)

params.sponsors: Array of addresses to authorize as sponsors USAGE EXAMPLE: // User's delegated EOA calls this to authorize multiple platform wallets address[] memory sponsors = [wallet1, wallet2, wallet3]; delegator.authorizeBatchSponsors(sponsors);

authorizeBatchSponsorsWithSignature(addr.details: Verifies EIP-712 signature to authorize multiple sponsors without requiring gas from user

params.deadline: The timestamp until which the signature is valid
params.r: Half of the ECDSA signature pair
params.s: Half of the ECDSA signature pair GASLESS BATCH WORKFLOW: 1. User signs EIP-712 message off-chain with sponsor array using eth_signTypedData 2. Platform calls this function with the signature (platform pays gas) 3. Signature is verified and all sponsors are authorized in single transaction 4. No gas required from user - completely gasless batch onboarding SIGNATURE MESSAGE STRUCTURE: - Domain: "EIP7702Delegator" version "1" - Message: user address, sponsors array, nonce, deadline - Prevents replay attacks via nonce and time-bounds via deadline
params.sponsors: Array of addresses to authorize as sponsors
params.v: The recovery byte of the signature

authorizeSponsor(address).details: Can only be called by the user themselves (when their EOA has this contract as implementation)

params.sponsor: The address to authorize as a sponsor (typically platform's funding wallet) USAGE EXAMPLE: // User's delegated EOA calls this to authorize platform's funding wallet delegator.authorizeSponsor(0x123...); // Platform's FUNDING_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY address

authorizeSponsorWithSignature(address,ui.details: Verifies EIP-712 signature to authorize sponsor without requiring gas from user

params.deadline: The timestamp until which the signature is valid
params.r: Half of the ECDSA signature pair
params.s: Half of the ECDSA signature pair GASLESS WORKFLOW: 1. User signs EIP-712 message off-chain using eth_signTypedData 2. Platform calls this function with the signature (platform pays gas) 3. No gas required from user - completely gasless onboarding SIGNATURE MESSAGE STRUCTURE: - Domain: "EIP7702Delegator" version "1" - Message: user address, sponsor address, nonce, deadline - Prevents replay attacks via nonce and time-bounds via deadline
params.sponsor: The address to authorize as a sponsor
params.v: The recovery byte of the signature
